results.title: Inclusion modulo finite
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For subsets $a$ and $b$ of a set $\alpha$, $a \subseteq^* b$ ($a$ is almost contained in $b$) if the difference $a \setminus b$ is finite.

results.title: P-ideal of countable sets
results.caption: Structure
results.summary: A family $I$ of subsets of a set $\alpha$ is a P-ideal of countable sets if every member of $I$ is countable, every subset of a member of $I$ is in $I$, every finite subset of $\alpha$ is in $I$, $I$ is closed under binary unions, and for every sequence $(a_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of members of $I$ there is $b \in I$ with $a_n \subseteq^* b$ (that is, $a_n \setminus b$ is finite) for every $n$.

results.title: Orthogonality to a family of sets
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $I$ be a family of subsets of a set $\alpha$. A set $X \subseteq \alpha$ is orthogonal to $I$ if $X \cap a$ is finite for every $a \in I$.

results.title: P-ideal dichotomy
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The P-ideal dichotomy (PID): for every P-ideal I of countable subsets of an uncountable set, either some uncountable set has all its countable subsets in I, or the whole set is a countable union of sets orthogonal to I.

results.title: Isomorphism-closed classes of groups (Kourovka 12.96)
results.caption: Structure
results.summary: A class of groups is a property of groups that is closed under isomorphism: if a group $H$ has the property and $K$ is a group isomorphic to $H$, then $K$ has it too.

results.title: Fitting classes of finite groups
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A class $\mathfrak{X}$ of groups is a Fitting class of finite groups if, for every finite group $G$, every normal subgroup of $G$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$ whenever $G$ does, and the product $N_1 N_2$ of two normal subgroups $N_1$ and $N_2$ of $G$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$ whenever $N_1$ and $N_2$ do.

results.title: Maximal subgroups within a class of groups
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a class of groups and let $V$ and $K$ be subgroups of a group $G$. Then $V$ is $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal in $K$ if $V \le K$, $V$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$, and no subgroup $W$ of $G$ with $V < W \le K$ lies in $\mathfrak{X}$.

results.title: Injectors
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $\mathfrak{X}$ be a class of groups and $G$ a group. A subgroup $V$ of $G$ is an $\mathfrak{X}$-injector of $G$ if, for every subnormal subgroup $N$ of $G$, the intersection $V \cap N$ is $\mathfrak{X}$-maximal in $N$.

results.title: Inert primes in prime cyclotomic fields
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\ell$ and $p$ be distinct prime numbers, and let $K$ be a number field that is an $\ell$-th cyclotomic extension of $\mathbb{Q}$, with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$.
